verdict.rationale: Data retention and PII deletion are a fair axis for an identity verification service that collects documents and biometrics. However, the evidence pack documents no retention windows, no redaction or deletion API, and no on-demand PII scrubbing. The citations cover only applicant creation, workflows, webhooks, authentication and report types, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control what happens to collected identity data — documented retention windows and a redaction or deletion API that scrubs PII on demand
